---
title: "Methods"
---

## Sea ice seasonality

Daily passive microwave sea ice concentration (the NOAA/NSIDC sea ice
concentration climate data record, 25 km south polar stereographic grid)
for 1979-2025. Following Massom et al. (2013), per pixel and per ice year
(15 February to 14 February):

- **advance**: first day of the first run of at least 5 consecutive days at
  or above 15% concentration
- **retreat**: first day after the last day at or above 15% (concentration
  stays below 15% to the end of the ice year); undefined if there is ice on
  the last day, or if there was no advance
- **duration** = retreat - advance; **day count** = days at or above 15%

Gaps of up to 5 days are interpolated; dates whose field is mostly empty
are treated as missing; the 1987 ice year is not computed because of the
SSM/I gap from 3 December 1987 to 13 January 1988. This reimplements an
earlier calculation and fixes its handling of pixels with ice at the end of
the year (previously given retreat day 1) and a one-day offset.

## Chlorophyll on the ice grid

Ocean colour: the merged multi-sensor 5-day chlorophyll-a composites
(Ocean Colour CCI v6.0, 4 km). Each composite is averaged onto the 25 km
ice grid as the mean of log~10~ chlorophyll, keeping an area-weighted count
of valid 4 km pixels. Composites are dated by their mid-day (start + 2).

For each composite with a mid-date from 1 September to 30 April and each
cell with a retreat that ice year, days since retreat (dsr) = day of the
ice year of the composite - retreat day; rows with dsr from -30 to 120 are
kept. About 9.8 million cell-composites over 29 ice years.

## Context

- **Ice nearby:** maximum ice concentration over the composite's 5 days in
  the cell and its 3x3 neighbourhood (~75 km); "clean" rows have none.
- **Open-water baseline:** chlorophyll in cells with no ice season that
  year, by composite, sector and 1-degree latitude band; each row is
  compared with the same composite and sector, in its own band where open
  water exists (the "near" baseline) or the nearest band.
- **Shelf:** GEBCO bathymetry averaged onto the grid; shelf = shallower
  than 1000 m.
- **Sectors:** Weddell (60W-20E), Indian (20E-90E), West Pacific
  (90E-160E), Ross (160E-130W), Bellingshausen-Amundsen (130W-60W).

## Ocean state

Daily mixed layer depth, surface temperature and surface salinity from the
Bluelink ReANalysis (BRAN2020, 0.1 degree), read in place on the NCI
supercomputer through kerchunk reference stores whose file paths were
remapped from the public THREDDS URLs to the local file system. Averaged to
the same 5-day calendar south of 48S and onto the ice grid, then
summarised per cell-year over the 20 days after retreat.

## Bloom metrics

Per cell-year: **peak** = maximum log~10~ chlorophyll over dsr 0-60 from
clean rows (at least 3 composites); **peak dsr** = its days since retreat.
Rank (Spearman) correlations are reported pooled, within sector, and within
cell (departures from each cell's mean over years, cells with at least 5
years).

## Reference

(2013). Change and variability in East Antarctic sea ice seasonality,
1979/80-2009/10. *PLoS ONE* 8(5): e64756.
